newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate falls nine bps in April.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate falls nine bps in April.

text.p: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate, the average bank term deposit cost measured in dollars in Mexican banks, was at 6.63 percent in April compared with 6.72 percent in March, the Banco de Mexico said on Monday.

In April 1996, the central bank started calculating this rate as an indicator that could be used a reference rate for dollar-denominated credits, including loans from foreign banks, financings from export-import banks and the Commodity Credit Corporation.
